name: Implicit Tree and Euler Characteristic
description: Removed explicit tree construction wording, replacing it with a connected network with m=n-1. Replaced the local degree sum formula with the global Euler characteristic (V - E = 1). Models must deduce that the graph is a tree and that V - E = 1 on a tree implies the active stations form a single connected component, defeating models that rely on explicit tree keywords to trigger tree-pruning algorithms.
